ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmonious? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmonious.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmonious.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmonious.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Harmonious.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of heat in? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of heat in.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of heat in.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of heat in.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of heat in.

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.

8. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Animals and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals and its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals and its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals and its resources.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and its resources.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Heat and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Heat and its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Heat and its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Heat and its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Heat and its resources.

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Communicating messages and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Engaging parents or and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for Soil environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Improving soil and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Glucose and oxygen

2. C — Producers

3. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmonious.

4. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of heat in.

5. A — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

6. A — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

7. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.

8. B — Ice melting to water

9. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals and its resources.

10. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and its resources.

11. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Heat and its resources.

12. C — 100 °C

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Communicating messages; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Engaging parents or; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Caring for Soil environment; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Improving soil; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
